en: Illustrated panoramic view over a river valley and the city below, seen from an elevated terrace with a railing and flowerbeds. On the right is a monumental stone pedestal bearing a crouching lion statue (Major Hackher monument). In the foreground, several people in early-20th‑century clothing stand on the terrace. In the background are hills and mountains surrounding the town. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as the Schlossberg and Major Hackher monument in Graz, with a view of the city.
